[[Main Page|Slay the Spire]] is divided into 3 distinct Acts. Each node on the map is represented by a [[Map Locations|Map Location]]. The Exordium begins by meeting {{E|Neow}} which give you the option to choose between a selection of up to 4 blessings and ends with a fight against a [[Bosses|Boss]]. Every Act has an unique selection of [[Events]], [[Monsters]], [[Elites]], and [[Bosses]].
